content: scikit-fda preprocessing: Smoothing — KernelSmoother (with NadarayaWatsonHatMatrix, LocalLinearRegressionHatMatrix, KNeighborsHatMatrix as hat matrix strategies), BasisSmoother (penalized basis expansion), SmoothingParameterSearch for CV-based bandwidth selection, LinearSmootherLeaveOneOutScorer, LinearSmootherGeneralizedCVScorer, CV criteria: akaike_information_criterion, finite_prediction_error, shibata, rice. Registration/Alignment — LeastSquaresShiftRegistration (shift only), FisherRaoElasticRegistration (SRSF-based elastic, full warping), landmark_shift_registration, landmark_shift_deltas, landmark_elastic_registration, landmark_elastic_registration_warping, invert_warping, normalize_warping. Registration validation: AmplitudePhaseDecomposition, LeastSquares, SobolevLeastSquares, PairwiseCorrelation. Missing data: MissingValuesInterpolation.
